source_snapshot.test_name: Type 17 - Memory Device Record - Device Locator
source_snapshot.items: Type 17 - Memory Device Record - Device Locator
source_snapshot.procedure: Check the test-item information, collect evidence and confirm it remains correct after reboot.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information is correct and remains correct after reboot.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek greps Device Locator strings without retaining Type 17 handles, array linkage, population context, expected slot map or a post-reboot comparison.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that every SMBIOS Type 17 Memory Device record has the correct platform-defined Device Locator and that the complete socket mapping remains correct after reboot.
original_test_intent.target: All Type 17 records required for every socketed memory location, populated or empty, plus any required soldered-memory record, linked to their Type 16 Physical Memory Array and owner physical slot map.
original_test_intent.scope: Read, map and compare every Device Locator before and after one approved reboot; do not limit the check to populated DIMMs or a grep list with no record identity.
original_test_intent.operation: Capture complete Type 16/17 structures and platform memory inventory, map each Type 17 handle/array/device locator to the physical socket and population state, compare against owner naming/uniqueness rules, obtain reboot approval, repeat the same collection/mapping and verify persistence plus host/BMC health.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Two read-only full-socket collections separated by one approved reboot; no DIMM movement or memory reconfiguration.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every required socket/soldered device has one non-null, unique-as-required Device Locator correctly mapped to the platform slot; populated and empty records follow the owner policy; the mapping is unchanged and correct after reboot; the host and management path recover normally.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/board/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity, approved physical socket/locator/population map, complete pre/post Type 16/17 output, Type 17 handle-to-array/slot reconciliation, optional approved BMC/SPD corroboration for populated DIMMs, reboot timeline and OS/BMC health.
ambiguities: The source gives no platform locator strings, physical socket map, normalization or uniqueness policy.
It does not state how empty sockets or soldered memory are represented.
The procedure omits the explicit reboot phase required by the criterion.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly expands the grep fragment into every Type 17 record, includes Type 16 links, physical slot/population reconciliation, owner naming policy, approved reboot and non-invasive evidence. DMTF 3.9.0 directly supports these requirements; no material correction is needed.

applicable_history.decision: The historical review accepts dmidecode execution but retains only locator fragments and delegates all mapping and persistence judgment.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2. Collection and mapping can be automated once the owner supplies the physical slot map and package/access; reboot remains approval-gated. Missing expected values do not prevent safe pre-reboot actual-value collection and do not justify BLOCKED.

available_now: DMTF requires one Type 17 structure for each socketed memory device location even when unpopulated, an additional record for soldered memory where present, and a non-null Device Locator.
Complete current Type 16/17 actual values can be collected read-only before the platform map is supplied.
V2 already preserves empty-slot handling, uniqueness, array linkage and no-hardware-change boundaries.
missing_inputs: Approved per-socket Device Locator strings, normalization/uniqueness policy, physical slot map and expected populated/empty/soldered-memory state
Exact board/memory recipe and approved mapping/corroboration source for DIMM serial/slot identity where needed
Validated dmidecode/parser and sudo/host access, reboot approval/workload isolation, stable power and OOB recovery
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/memory/BIOS owner supplies the physical socket/locator/population map; the lab/system owner supplies validated tooling/access and approves the reboot/recovery window.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect dmidecode/SMBIOS versions and complete Type 16/17 records without filtering or clearing logs
Build a provisional handle/array/locator/size/serial/population table and optional read-only BMC/SPD correlation, reporting actual values without PASS
prohibited_until_closed: Do not declare PASS from a non-empty locator list, inspect only populated DIMMs, infer physical slot order, suppress duplicate/blank records or normalize strings without owner policy
Do not install/remove/reseat DIMMs, alter memory/firmware settings, clear logs or reboot without approval and OOB recovery
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The signed owner map accounts for every physical socket and soldered device, maps all Type 17/Type 16 handles and population states, defines normalization/uniqueness, and can be compared with validated complete output before and after an approved recoverable reboot.

revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every required SMBIOS Type 17 Device Locator against the physical memory-slot map and confirm the complete mapping persists after one reboot.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board, CPU/memory population and BIOS/SMBIOS build with an owner-approved socket map, validated dmidecode, host access, an approved reboot window and console/BMC/OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All Type 17 records for populated and empty memory sockets plus any soldered-memory record, linked by Type 16 Memory Array Handle and physical slot identity; not a locator-only grep list.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Per-socket expected locator/population map; normalization and uniqueness rules; board/memory recipe; optional approved BMC/SPD correlation; dmidecode/parser version and sudo access; reboot approval, workload isolation, power/OOB recovery and evidence destination.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Collect complete pre-reboot Type 16/17 structures; map each handle/array/device locator and population state to the signed physical slot map; compare every record; after explicit approval reboot once; repeat identical collection/mapping and verify persistence plus OS/BMC health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/board/BIOS/memory recipe selected; full socket map signed; dmidecode/parser validated; least-privilege access available; workload quiesced; reboot window, power and OOB recovery ready; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed slot/locator/population matrix; platform/tool versions; complete unfiltered pre/post Type 16/17 output; handle/array/slot/size/serial table; optional BMC/SPD corroboration; exact comparison; reboot timeline; OS/BMC health and exceptions.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: DMTF DSP0134 SMBIOS 3.9.0 Type 17 data requirements plus the exact platform memory-slot naming/population specification.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Use read-only inventory only. Do not move DIMMs, alter firmware/memory settings, omit empty sockets, infer physical order, clear logs or reboot without approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform/memory owner supplies and accepts the physical map; system/workload owner approves reboot and resolves discrepancies. Ordinary pre-reboot read-only collection needs no additional approval.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Owners provide physical slot truth and reboot authorization. Once supplied, record extraction, mapping, comparison and approved reboot orchestration can be automated; physical inspection is only needed to resolve disputed mapping.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If reboot or management recovery fails, stop and use approved console/BMC/OOB recovery. On locator/population mismatch, preserve complete SMBIOS and corroborating evidence; do not manipulate memory hardware under this case.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing slot map/policy, unresolved handle/array/physical mapping, blank/duplicate/ambiguous locator, incomplete record set, pre-test mismatch, missing reboot approval/recovery, boot/management failure or post-reboot mapping drift.

identified_defects: DeepSeek's grep cannot bind a locator to its Type 17 handle, array, population or physical socket and omits reboot persistence.
The source lacks the owner-specific slot map and empty/soldered-memory representation needed for correctness.
reason_for_change: No material V2 change is warranted: its all-record Type 16/17 mapping, empty-slot policy, read-only boundary and reboot comparison match both the source intent and DMTF requirements.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF DSP0134 SMBIOS Specification
new_technical_evidence.applicability: SMBIOS Type 17 structures; actual SUT SMBIOS version must be recorded
new_technical_evidence.supports: A Type 17 record is required for each socketed memory location whether populated or not, plus soldered memory where present; Device Locator must be non-null and Memory Array Handle must link to Type 16.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The standard does not supply the ODM physical slot names or expected population map.

removed_ambiguities: V2 already defines every-record scope, empty-slot handling, Type 16 linkage and physical-map acceptance.
resolved_blockers: Missing expected locators do not prevent safe collection of actual complete Type 17 data; they gate comparison only.
remaining_blockers: PASS and reboot remain gated by the complete owner slot/population map, validated package/access, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: None required; KEEP is correct because V2 already converts the locator fragment into a standards-aligned all-socket mapping and persistence test without physical DIMM changes or premature PASS.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator retained all populated, empty and soldered-memory Type 17 Device Locator records, signed slot mapping and one authorized reboot.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source checks SMBIOS Type 17 Device Locator correctness and requires that information to remain correct after reboot.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 adds the exact all-record, Type 16-linked, physical-slot and population evidence missing from DeepSeek without altering the read-only intent.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Inventory all populated/empty/soldered locations read-only, compare with owner physical truth and reboot only after approval/OOB readiness; never alter DIMM placement to make data match.
